scope.summary: One round of concealed-choice rock-paper-scissors, with a draw ending the round.
excludes: Match scoring and physical gesture conventions
Physical gesture and timing conventions remain unspecified.

rules.statement: Each player can choose rock, paper or scissors.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: Start with neither player committed to a choice.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: Both players commit before either choice is revealed.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: Each player selects and commits one choice.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: A committed choice cannot be changed during this round.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: Keep each choice hidden from the opponent until both have committed, then reveal both.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: Rock defeats scissors, scissors defeats paper, and paper defeats rock; the player with the defeating choice wins.

origin.attribution: Original synthetic configuration by fictional fixture author.

rules.statement: Equal choices end this round as a draw.
